name: Classic Hash Browns

manufacturer.name: Heinz Wattie's Limited
manufacturer.address: 513 King Street North, Hastings 4122, New Zealand

ingredients: Potatoes (89%), Canola Oil (9%), Seasoning, Mineral Salt (450), Dextrose.
storage: Keep Frozen. Store at -18°C or colder. Do not thaw before cooking. Do not refreeze once thawed. Product must be cooked before use.
note: Trans fat is printed as 'LESS THAN 0.1 g' in both columns - not a number, so omitted. Polyunsaturated (2.7 g/100 g) and monounsaturated (6.2 g/100 g) are on the label but have no allowed key. The country-of-origin line runs off the bottom edge of the frame ('Made in Ne…'), so origin stays in needs; the front carries a 'GROWN [NZ] POTATOES' roundel and 'POTATO FROM THE CANTERBURY PLAINS'. Servings per package is printed as 'Approx. 19.5'. Pack also states 'NOT SUITABLE FOR COOKING IN A TOASTER.'
